newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks 50,000T soft red French wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks 50,000T soft red French wheat.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Monday he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of soft red wheat from France for loading between December 16 and December 31.
Samir Shakankiri told Reuters the deadline for receiving bids was 9 a.m. local time (0700 gmt) on Friday, November 15.
Bids are valid until Monday, November 18, he said.
Shakankiri said earlier this week he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of soft white Australian wheat and 100,000 tonnes of Argentinian wheat by Friday.
